title: Chicken Quesadilla (Meal Prep)
description: 12 chicken quesadillas with an avocado-mint dip — made in bulk, individually wrapped and frozen for up to 3 months.

ingredients.text: 2 avocados + 2 tbsp Greek yogurt + mint + 2 lime juice
34g olive oil, 6g each garlic powder, cayenne, onion powder, cumin, paprika

steps: Season chicken; fry in batches 1 min each side; remove. Stir-fry onions and peppers.
Make avocado dip: mash avocado with yogurt, mint, lime, salt and garlic.
Lay out tortillas; add 20g cheese, spoonful of avo dip and chicken-veg mixture to each.
Fold into quesadillas; fry in oil 1 min each side until golden.
Wrap each in parchment + zip-lock. Freeze up to 3 months or refrigerate 5 days.
notes: Reheat in microwave 2 min or air-fry from defrosted at 180°C 3–4 min.
